comment: Jeff is simply the best. He was my professor for the SSIR class Social Entrepreneurship and Prosocial Behavior and he was just amazing. All of the students became close to him and his wonderful family. Extremely helpful inside and outside the classroom. I think our relationship as students with him as a professor was different because of the SSIR
He motivates and helps wherever needed. Assigned reading is helpful and interesting. He is engaging at all times. My favorite professor ever!
Nice guy. Flexible and understanding with students. He tries to make sure everyone does well in class and that the students get exactly what they want from class. Easy grader
Best professor ever! So helpful, very fast at responding to your emails, and great personality that inspires students to learn!

The whole class consists of writing a business plan which accounts for 90% of your grade, the other 10% is participation. Most classes are dedicated to working on your plan. Very little reading required. Dr. Pollack is exceptionally helpful. He will do whatever he can to make the students have a good experience. Not a very structured class.
awesome teacher, incredibly nice and helpful, and good at what he does
Best professor I have ever had, hands down.
